redfin.remarks: Welcome to 22312 Delia Court, a beautiful home in Mulholland Heights, tucked into a quiet Calabasas double cul-de-sac. The home is served by the highly regarded Las Virgenes Unified School District, with AC Stelle Middle School and Calabasas High School both within walking distance. The location combines everyday convenience with the best of the Calabasas lifestyle. Enjoy a charming community atmosphere along with world-class golf, exceptional dining, scenic hiking trails, and abundant natural beauty? located near Universal Studios and the beaches of Malibu. Filled with natural light, the home features soaring vaulted ceilings, expansive windows, and an open, inviting floor plan. The main level is highlighted by beautiful real hardwood floors and offers a formal living and dining room , spacious family room , and updated kitchen overlooking the pool and backyard—creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. Also on this level are a private ensuite bedroom , guest bathroom, and generously sized laundry room. Upstairs, a large bonus/family room provides flexible space for relaxing, working, or gathering. Two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom accompany the serene primary suite. The spacious primary retreat features abundant natural light, peaceful backyard views, a cozy fireplace, and a large walk-in closet. The? primary bathroom includes a soaking tub, separate shower, and dual sinks. Designed for quintessential Southern California living, the backyard is a private retreat with a sparkling pool, drought-conscious turf, stone pavers, and a covered patio perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining. Solar panels add energy efficiency and potential cost savings, complementing the environmentally conscious lifestyle for which Calabasas is known. Whether you’re looking to upsize, downsize, or simply enjoy a beautiful home in an exceptional location, 22312 Delia Court offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and California living.
